objective: Make rendering preparation an explicit, testable value-only boundary and evaluate bounded parallel computation without changing simulation state or draw order.

ownership.inputs: value copies captured by renderer owner
ownership.outputs: Fixed-index frame-local results; all submitted tasks completed before owner submission. Persistent workers joined at renderer teardown.
ownership.worker_pool: dedicated renderer-owned instance of existing cata_thread_pool; no global experimental switch
ownership.reentrancy: Owner-thread RAII lease protects captured results until outer draw consumption ends. Nested requests use the direct serial kernel; leases release on exceptions and move without double release.

batch28_scope: Extract sparse-layer decisions and colored-light tint math into a graphics-backend-independent module.
Capture transient overrides, creature/shadow presence and light scalars on the main thread.
Use the same pure kernel for serial and bounded worker batches. Preserve z/row/tile/layer order.
Keep default worker count zero until paired full-pipeline measurements establish a benefit. Small batches fall back to serial.
Test legacy output parity, independent inputs, output ownership, empty/small/large batches and worker teardown.
Avoid full-frame copies for fewer than16384 entries, and preserve parent result buffers during nested draws.
acceptance: Formatting and focused regression; reuse other unchanged evidence.
Release SDL3 game and focused native test build.
Focused memory/safety checks of the new value boundary; report actual sanitizer support.
Fixed input-size/lighting-distribution before/after kernel and full capture/preparation timings.
Actual fullscreen UndeadPeople/OpenGL Damon test copies; fixed inputs, native save/reload and original file hashes.
No speedup claim from hotspot share, microbenchmark alone, or incomplete simulation trials.

later_batches.entry: Use fixed carrier views/aiming and rebuild counts to establish repeated work or expensive independent scan segments.
later_batches.deliverable: Freeze observer inputs and cache dependencies; version invalidation explicitly; parallelize only independent read-only work after duplicate rebuilds are removed.
later_batches.acceptance: Two-map ownership, walls/traps/local changes, observer changes and repeat-view parity; native fixed action trials. Keep observer and gameplay RNG order.

later_batches.entry: First distinguish missing-map generation, existing-map read/deserialization, memory preparation and SDL texture upload on a fixed unexplored route.
later_batches.deliverable: Start with the measured blocking stage. Background IO can return owned byte buffers; only proven-safe value decoding may run away from the world owner. Validate location/revision before applying results.
later_batches.acceptance: Cold/warm/saved-memory scenes, repeated movement, save/reload and unload during pending work. Preserve Lua hooks, IDs and generation randomness; do not move arbitrary map generation to workers.

later_batches.entry: Dense-monster fixed carrier scenario with completed turns; measure sensing, path search/scoring and movement separately.
later_batches.deliverable: Read-only proposals from fixed inputs; deterministic main-thread movement/combat commit in existing entity order. Recompute or reject stale proposals.
later_batches.acceptance: Same seed/input produces matching decisions and selected state; collision/conflicting proposals/death/lifecycle tests and scoped race checks. Gameplay and Lua mutations stay on the owner.

later_batches.entry: Value preparation has safe lifecycle and representative cost evidence; identify remaining live creature/light/memory queries.
later_batches.deliverable: Complete pointer-free semantic views and stable ordered commands; keep backend asset lookup/submission separate. This supplies a boundary for a future 3D renderer without replacing simulation.
later_batches.acceptance: Orthogonal/isometric views, colored lights, overrides, map memory, renderer recovery and asset reload. Verify output/lifetime before considering asynchronous frames.

stop_rules: Do not enable worker path by default after a slowdown or ambiguous end-to-end result.
Keep Lua, gameplay RNG, shared map mutation and SDL outside workers.
estimated_changed_lines: 948 changed lines; reference<=15 commits; planned3coherent local commits for compiler compatibility, implementation/regression and plan/evidence.
publication: local commits only; no automatic merge or release

architecture.style: Modular monolith. Preserve existing game model and save identities; extract real responsibilities in bounded batches, not an engine-wide ECS or replacement universal context.
architecture.boundary: Owner captures immutable values -> bounded jobs compute fixed-index results -> owner validates and applies in original order.
architecture.scheduler_growth: Start with renderer-owned synchronous work. Consolidate bounded scheduling only when a second proven batch needs it; do not create one unbounded pool per subsystem.
architecture.three_dimensional_rendering: Extend semantic views and ordered render commands behind a backend interface. Current mask/tint values are only a small preparation boundary; they are not a complete world snapshot or 3D renderer.

measurement_protocol.baseline: Freeze binary and source commit; copy the same native save for each trial. Keep seed, mods, UndeadPeople, fullscreen dimensions, zoom, rendering backend and input sequence fixed.
measurement_protocol.pairing: Control/candidate/candidate/control where practical, without a concurrent build. Record actual native saved turns and positions before comparing.
measurement_protocol.diagnosis: Function-level perf cycles/call stacks identify CPU execution. Record capture, value preparation, SDL submission, IO/cache rebuild boundaries separately. A sampled share is not frame latency or GPU time.
measurement_protocol.acceptance: Default-on requires repeatable representative full-pipeline benefit, unchanged selected simulation/save state and no material regression in smaller scenes. Microbenchmarks alone do not qualify.
measurement_protocol.disclosure: Report medians/tails, sample counts, collector losses, unknown symbols, per-thread scope, configuration and artifact hashes. Explicitly retain pending gameplay/replay/multiplayer/device gates.
measurement_protocol.control: Compile original renderer source with the current shared header/layout and current objects/options/pool safety. Recompile the renderer withClang23 for both paths; restore final source and verify byte-identical candidate. OldClang22 frozen baseline remains useful for behavior, not source-attributable CPU delta.

safety_acceptance.value_parity: Legacy decisions and exact RGBA; independent frames, repeated capture, odd partitions and worker counts0/1/2/4.
safety_acceptance.failure_lifecycle: Drain submitted tasks on allocation failure; stop/join partial pool startup; lease release on successful, moved and exceptional owner exits.
safety_acceptance.native_state: Native saved route endpoint and player fields; normalize only learned_recipes using its pointer-set serialization contract, never arbitrary ordered arrays.
safety_acceptance.performance_default: Workers remain0 unless the complete scene shows repeatable benefit; no default-on claim from a copied-value microbenchmark.

next_batch_decision: Use final function-level perf tables to choose between live render-command preparation and visibility cache scans. This batch isolates layer/tint values only; it does not claim that this small kernel is the dominant hotspot.
